translations.translatedText: # Monday 14.12.2020 (radio)

8 new coronavirus deaths were reported in Finland. Parliament has started to deal with the health and social services reform. Stockmann is selling its department store building in central Helsinki. Google's online services have had problems. Rain arrives in Finland on Tuesday.
## Coronavirus figures

![A nurse in protective clothing takes a sample from the nose of a person sitting in a car at a coronavirus testing point.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11671186)
Open image viewer
New coronavirus infections have been found in coronavirus tests. Photo: Mika Halme / Yle
The number of coronavirus deaths in Finland has grown. On Monday, 8 new coronavirus deaths were reported. In total, 461 people have died in Finland because of the coronavirus.
On Monday, 300 new coronavirus infections were also reported. About 31,000 coronavirus infections have been reported in Finland in total.
## Health and social services reform
![General view of the chamber during a plenary session of Parliament in Helsinki.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11694477)
Open image viewer
Parliament decides on Finland's laws. Photo: Vesa Moilanen / Lehtikuva
Parliament, that is, the Finnish Parliament, has started to deal with the reform of health and social services. Health and social services means social and health services.
Parliament is dealing with the government's proposal on health and social services. The government wants to divide Finland into regions that will organise all health and social services.
At present, municipalities organise health and social services. However, Finland has small municipalities that do not have the money to organise good services.
The big health and social services regions can run the services better, the government says. Then people get good care across the whole of Finland, and money can be saved.
The opposition parties think that the government's proposal will not improve health and social services. The opposition says that the reform will not save money either.
## Stockmann

![Stockmann's department store in central Helsinki with Christmas lights, 14.12.2020.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5978,h_3363,x_0,y_495/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7539345fd7654ee895f/1708683257)
Open image viewer
Stockmann department store in Helsinki. Photo: Jari Kovalainen / Yle
Stockmann is selling its department store building in central Helsinki. Stockmann's business will continue in the building, but Stockmann will become a tenant of the building's new owner.
Stockmann is also selling its department store buildings in the Estonian capital Tallinn and the Latvian capital Riga. In these cities too, Stockmann will continue to operate as a tenant.
Selling the buildings is part of a programme to try to improve Stockmann's finances. Stockmann has a lot of debt, and the coronavirus crisis has made Stockmann's finances worse still.
## Google's problems
![iPhone.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5052,h_2842,x_0,y_529/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-5107665ba211ffc61a9/1723036768)
Open image viewer
Many people also use Google's services at work. Photo: Carolina Husu / Yle
Google's online services had problems on Monday.
There were problems in many countries, for example the USA, India and Finland. For example, the Gmail email service and the YouTube video service did not work normally.
Google's problems disrupted the work of millions of people.
## Weather
![weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11696947)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
On Tuesday a rain area will arrive in Finland. In the south it will rain, and in the middle of the country it will snow.
The weather will also get milder. There are plus temperatures in southern Finland. In Lapland there is a little frost.
On Wednesday new rain will arrive in the south. During the day the rain will be water or sleet. On Wednesday evening the weather gets colder in the south too, and the rain may come as snow.
